communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Arizona Public Records Law, I hereby request the following records:

All available contracting and procurement documents and communications, including requests for proposals (RFPs) and/or requests for quotes (RFQs); all bids and proposals; all executed contracts with amendments, extensions, and supportive materials (active and expired); and any related agreements between Arizona Department of Corrections and/or Arizona State Government and private healthcare contracting corporations that were active or published between January 1, 2001 and December 31, 2025. This includes any contracts that were active before 2001 and were in effect during the period of interest.  

If healthcare operations for incarcerated individuals in Arizona State Prisons were contracted to entities other than private healthcare contracting corporations (ex. Universities), we would request the same available documents during active or published between January 1, 2001 and December 31, 2025.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Elizabeth Evans-Ralston

title: Quote Q-465809 Referenced in Amendment 2 of Contract 3352

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Minnesota Government Data Practices Act, I hereby request the following records:

Please provide a copy of "Quote Q-465809" Referenced in Amendment 2 of Contract 3352.

On 6/23/26 the Pioneer Press published the following article:  https://www.twincities.com/2026/06/23/st-paul-police-docked-drones-responding-911-calls

This article states that SPPD acquired three docked drones for $350,000. It also states that SPPD has a total of 17-20 drones in total. To date, none of the documents that the city has provided reconcile to the information that SPPD provided to the Pioneer Press. We are asking that the city provides whatever documentation they have that substantiates the Pioneer Press article. We are asking for the paper trail that says the city has 17-20 drones, including the three docked drones for $350,000. The "Amendment 2" document that the city attorney's office provided to CM Kim's staff does not reconcile to what the Pioneer Press article states - it says 12 hardware licenses and compensation of $129,749.36 over five years. 

Please provide "Quote Q-465809" Referenced in Amendment 2 of Contract 3352, and/or any documentation substantiating the number of drones and cost reported to the Pioneer Press on 6/23/26.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Eyes Off Saint Paul
